name: Beat-Up 35mm Camera
description: Peter's trusty camera. Must be equipped to turn crime encounters into sellable photos. Can break under fire.

name: Bronze-Grade Camera
description: Salvaged glass, properly mounted. Half as likely to break under fire as the beat-up 35mm, and 1 shot in 5 comes out a quality tier better than it should have. Not for sale at any price — it is handed out for reaching level 10 in the community server, and it shoots at stock numbers anywhere else. Fitting it strips any older camera body you own for parts: the old one is gone, not stashed.

name: Silver-Grade Camera
description: A real upgrade over the beat-up 35mm — sturdier housing and a better lens. Far less likely to break under fire, and a real shot at bumping a photo up a quality tier. Arachnid+ Patreon subscribers only. Fitting it strips any older camera body you own for parts: the old one is gone, not stashed.

name: Gold-Grade Camera
description: The best glass money can buy. Almost nothing short of a direct hit puts it out of action, and 4 shots in 5 come out a quality tier better than they had any right to. Symbiote Patreon subscribers only. Fitting it strips any older camera body you own for parts: the old one is gone, not stashed.

name: Spandex Fabric
description: Suit repair component. Scavenged on patrol crime encounters, or buy it here as a pricier fallback.

name: Micro-Electronics
description: Suit repair component for web-shooter and lens electronics. Rarer patrol scavenge, or buy it here in a pinch.

name: Web-Fluid Vial
description: A stable batch out of the Chem Lab. Sells fine on the Trade Post.

name: Unstable Web-Fluid
description: A batch that came out wrong in the best way. Doesn't do anything — doesn't need to. Half the server wants one just to say they've got one.

name: Bodega Flowers
description: Cheap and it works — the first few times. Bring these every visit and they'll stop meaning anything.

name: Dinner Takeout
description: A real gesture, not just a reflex. Still loses its shine if it's all you ever bring.

name: Jewelry
description: Expensive enough to actually land, even on a bad week.

name: Web-Shooters
description: The classic. Rapid-fire webbing to pin an enemy down before they land a hit. Chance to fully block incoming suit damage on patrol.

name: Web Grabber
description: Pulls enemies into a cluster for an easy multi-hit — and a grateful crowd tends to notice. Chance of a bonus cash donation on patrol.

name: Ricochet Web
description: A bouncing web projectile that ricochets between targets, tearing gear loose along the way. Chance of a big bonus to component scavenging on patrol.

name: Upshot
description: Launches enemies straight up for an airborne combo — the kind of takedown that's worth telling people about. Chance of bonus reputation XP on patrol.

name: Concussion Burst
description: A shockwave that blows back a whole group at once. The best defensive gadget there is — chance to halve suit damage and keep your camera safe on patrol.

name: Spider Bots
description: A swarm of palm-sized drones that dart in on their own — no aiming required, just extra damage while the fight's still going. Arachnid+ Patreon subscribers only.

name: Electric Webbing
description: Web fluid cut with a live current. Fires automatically on a landed hit — bonus damage and the shock keeps them from swinging back that round. Arachnid+ Patreon subscribers only.
